lede_html: Awards rose to 52 this week from 35, and EPC items rose to 98 from 78. The largest open tickets are in European rail and ports: Romania's CFR wants bids by 23 Nov on a US$864m, 7-lot track superstructure tender, and Dublin Port has put out a US$280m civil works framework. MCC took two Chinese EPC awards, a US$175m blast furnace and a US$143m limestone mine. For bidders, the pattern is public owners in Europe bundling maintenance and civil work into lots and frameworks, so line up partners and suppliers before the deadlines, not after.

deals_why.Railway maintenance works - Replacement: Seven lots let mid-sized track contractors and rail component suppliers bid for a share of US$864m, and the 23 Nov deadline leaves about five weeks to price.
deals_why.Electrification Rurale 2027-2030: A local syndicate is buying four years of rural electrification for US$20m: steady, small-ticket work for regional line contractors and network equipment suppliers until 2030.
deals_why.Multi-Party Framework Agreement for Civi: A multi-party framework means several contractors will share US$280m of port civil works, so getting onto the panel matters more than winning any single job.
deals_why.Fujian Dadonghai high-end steel industry: Fujian Dadonghai is adding blast furnace capacity and has booked MCC as EPC, so furnace equipment and refractory suppliers should pitch to MCC, not the owner.
deals_why.Ruyang County Yude Mining limestone mini: A US$143m EPC for a limestone mine that feeds cement shows MCC taking mining work outside steel, so equipment vendors should treat MCC as the buyer.
deals_why.Dams and similar structures - AM MULTISE: This US$98m framework books the Spanish contractor group for dam civil works until 2031, which leaves outsiders little room until the work is re-tendered.
deals_why.Design and construction of two rescue an: Two rescue vessels worth US$89m book Astilleros Armon Vigo, which will take up yard capacity that other owners may be looking for.
deals_why.Small-scale electricity generation with: Sinfra's US$30m ORC tender is an opening for heat-recovery and turbine package suppliers, but no deadline is listed, so check the notice directly.
deals_why.Kauno rajono PEB solar power acquisition: A Lithuanian municipality is tendering US$25m of solar; EPC installers and module suppliers should check the notice, as no deadline is listed.
deals_why.Design, Supply and Installation of the M: A Chinese consortium won this World Bank-financed line and substation job at US$7.8m, a guide to the prices rivals face in African transmission.
deals_why.Requalification and Recovery Works of Ca: A Brazilian contractor won this World Bank-financed dam rehabilitation at US$1.7m, which shows local firms take work of this size.
deals_why.Delivery of Four Autotransformers 350,00: Four 400 kV autotransformers for US$30m works out at roughly US$7.5m each, a useful benchmark, though the notice does not name the supplier.

flows_why.https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/con: Carriers are raising rates on some lanes, adding Americas calls and slowly returning to Suez, so shippers should recheck contract rates and routings.
flows_why.https://www.rigzone.com/news/wire/aramco: Aramco's Chinese refinery venture has taken its first crude cargo, so Saudi crude has a new outlet in China and rival refiners should watch allocations.
flows_why.https://splash247.com/suez-tightens-tran: Ships aged 25 years and older now face mandatory inspections and trials at Suez, so charterers should check vessel age before fixing Suez routings.
flows_why.https://oilprice.com/Energy/Natural-Gas/: Middle East LNG supply has still not meaningfully recovered seven and a half months after the Iran war, so buyers should expect continued pressure on alternative supply.
